description: This file contains utility functions for converting session server states to strings, converting logging levels, and setting log levels for different components within the rialto server manager's common namespace.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a SessionServerState enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a service::LoggingLevel enum to a RIALTO_DEBUG_LEVEL.

methods.name: setLocalLogLevels
methods.description: Sets log levels for various components based on provided LoggingLevels.
